ApiResponse.description:
Standard API response envelope. Identical shape for EVERY status code — 200, 201, 400, 401, 500, etc. Client code always decodes to ApiResponse<T> and checks `success`.

success=true  → `data` has the typed payload, `error` is null.
success=false → `data` is null, `error` has details.

data.description: Typed response payload on success. null on failure or no-content actions (logout, delete, etc.). Concrete type is specified per-endpoint via allOf composition.

error.description: Error details on failure. Always null on success.

meta.description: Response metadata: request tracing, pagination, timestamps.

success.description: true when the operation succeeded, false on any error.

CasbinRule.description:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1. CasbinRule — raw Casbin policy/grouping rows stored in PostgreSQL.
    Casbin gorm-adapter reads/writes this table directly.
    p-type rows: ptype="p"  → policy line: sub, dom, obj, act, eft
    g-type rows: ptype="g"  → role assignment: sub, dom, role
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

ptype.description:
ptype: "p" = policy line, "g" = role-inheritance line
 @inject_tag: gorm:"size:10;uniqueIndex:unique_index"

v1.description:
v1: domain   (p-line: portal:tenant) | role (g-line: role:<name>)
 NOTE: For g3 grouping rules the Casbin column order is (sub, role, domain):
   v0 = member/user,  v1 = role,  v2 = domain
 @inject_tag: gorm:"size:256;uniqueIndex:unique_index"

v2.description:
v2: object   (p-line: svc:resource) | domain (g-line: portal:tenant)
 NOTE: For g3 grouping rules the Casbin column order is (sub, role, domain):
   v0 = member/user,  v1 = role,  v2 = domain
 @inject_tag: gorm:"size:256;uniqueIndex:unique_index"

v3.description:
v3: action   (p-line: HTTP verb / domain action)
 @inject_tag: gorm:"size:256;uniqueIndex:unique_index"

v5.description:
v5: reserved for future ABAC conditions / attribute matchers
 @inject_tag: gorm:"size:256;uniqueIndex:unique_index"

 portal mapping:

   BUSINESS_BENEFICIARY  → portal: "business"   (email OTP + web server-side
   session) SYSTEM_USER           → portal: "system"     (email OTP + web
   server-side session) PARTNER               → portal: "b2b"        (email
   OTP + web server-side session) REGULATOR             → portal: "regulator"
   (email OTP + web server-side session, read-only)
